reel_check.SOURCE: primary read in full: yes: Rockstar's GTA VI Extended Look (27 Aug 2026, Rockstar's own master file) shows every activity on screen; PlayStation's GTA VI PS5 features trailer (10 Nov 2026) names adaptive triggers and haptic feedback on its own title cards
reel_check.SOURCE: not already posted: yes: no gameplay-activities Reel in the ledger
reel_check.ANGLE before lines: yes: hook what you do in Leonida besides missions; why now 3 days to launch; for players here what the game plays like; payoff the skydive over Vice City
reel_check.STORY TYPE trailer or first look: yes: what the footage shows: diving, an airboat in the swamp, circuit racing, motorbikes, basketball, skydiving with a parachute; the PS5 controller features as PlayStation names them
reel_check.STORY: spoken paragraph, subject before: yes: «غوص وسباقات وقفز حر في GTA VI. من عرض روكستار في أغسطس: سباقات على الحلبات، وبالدراجة النارية في الشوارع، وطرق ترابية للدراجات. الزنادات التكيفية والاستجابة اللمسية على PS5. وأخيرًا قفز بالمظلة فوق Vice City.» No line opens on و
reel_check.STORY: names: yes: Rockstar and PlayStation in Arabic with the Latin at first mention; PS5 and Vice City in English
reel_check.SENSITIVE: yes, handled: no weapons, no shooting, no swimwear shots (the jetty dive at 1042.5 left out); v1's gym shot (crop-top midriff) and free fall (close rear view in short shorts) dropped for a jet ski and the open parachute; v2 jet ski (swimwear from behind) and dirt bike (close rear view, crop top and shorts) dropped for an airboat and basketball
reel_check.SOUND: footage sound or bed with reason: yes: PlayStation's PS5 features trailer music stem from 3.0 s (music_only); the trailer has no speech; no other episode uses it
reel_check.PICTURE: footage first: yes: Rockstar's Extended Look master (stream reads, frame-exact) and PlayStation's trailer
reel_check.PICTURE: not the same picture as the las: yes: picture: the underwater cave (Extended Look 1037); not in the last five
reel_check.PICTURE: credit on every clip: yes: shots 0 to 8, PlayStation named on its two shots
